name: disable_selected_object_control

stack.evidence: func_001EB8A0 queues operation type 14 without accessing the Script value stack; the object-operation dispatcher sets the control-disable flag 0x100000000 in the selected object's flags at +0x440 and clears object-state flag 0x4

notes: Operation type 14 maps to the embedded CONTROL_OFF name. For either non-player party object, the dispatcher also resets transient state through func_001735B8 and func_001541E8. Across the JP corpus, 123 of its 287 calls immediately precede command 336 disable_script_object_damage.
